hero.headline:
Elevating events,
one sip at a time.
hero.intro: Mobile coffee bar bringing the café experience to you. Combining expertly crafted barista coffee with beautiful design and a personal touch, we make every occasion that little bit more special. From weddings and private celebrations to corporate events and brand activations, we're here to elevate your event, one sip at a time.

positioning.headline:
Your favourite café,
brought to you.
positioning.body: Using professional barista grade equipment and locally roasted Surrey coffee beans, Sip Social brings the authentic café experience straight to your event. Beautifully crafted coffee, thoughtfully served, wherever the occasion.

packagesSection.heading: Three ways to work with us
packagesSection.subtext: Every event is different, so pick the shape that fits yours...or talk to us and we'll help you choose.

eventTypesSection.heading: Built for your kind of event
eventTypesSection.subtext: From a wedding morning to a conference hall, our coffee bar adapts to wherever you need it.

howItWorksSection.heading: How it works
howItWorksSection.subtext: No price list, because no two events need the same thing — just a quick back-and-forth to get your quote right.

instagramSection.heading: Follow along
instagramSection.subtext: The latest from events, pop-ups and the cart itself.
